chapter: Army service in World War I
title: Landing at Newport News and the camp commander story
summary: Jim recalls landing at Newport News and a colored camp commander being made to dig trenches.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I left Newport News, but in the land, in North of Virginia. Newport News, Newport News, in North, across, they built a terminal there, you see? Yeah, yeah. Answer it? We went business, we built a terminal there, I built to, is that right? I built to that. Listen, and the, the land is over there, and so, on the fourth of, we land there, was, on, on, on, in, July 1st, the fourth was, a couple of days of, right, you know, and had, it got that, it, it, it, it all second band, that, it all second, colored band, what I'm going to play, you see? And so, there's, there's, there's, those, told us to have his boy, understand, told us to have his boy, and then, told us to have his boy, different places where they come from, Mississippi, and different things, and, other words, and that's where. What they, what they did, what they did, so, so one morning, one morning, they come in, they had a camp commander, colored fellow, understand, well he had his boy. He wants to make us go, make us go dig trenches around our public tents. You know? And let's, we, we wasn't supposed to do nothing. We supposed to come to this, not yet that, took us, took the trucks, and move us back in the woods, in the woods. And y'all come to camp commander, came back there, and she all said, all our, we even friends, said, what y'all doing back here? We're toiling, we're toiling, this, this camp, he's going to us back there. What they did with him? took them, took them, took them, took them, took that thing off him, and made him, dug them trenches, with a, with a bow knife. You can't walk in, see the bars? Yeah, made him do that, you understand? Made him do that. I said, man,
you need something. I've seen the captain,

made a private soldier. Made him did that, took sides, took sides, and the bow knife, made him, you know, you cut the trenches around your property, cause we sleep in the end, cause, we, we was on the ground, cause snake could boil us too. He had to put us back there, see how my make, and the next one, they came back there, and, and had this, had them, had them trucked them, and got by us. Let me tell you one thing, Lord, just to get my money. Get my money. Look, we had my big hat, they say, peon, gotta run and get it. Yeah, yeah,
